title: The Last Days of Lordaeron
note: Text ids refer to war3map.wts of each mission folder; every locale folder uses the same ids. Heroes: sections of the game's string files (see tools/fk_heroes.py), all languages.

lines.label: HRE01-C010-010-LANDEN
lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: At attention, guardsmen. Prince Arthas has returned from Northrend! With any luck, he has brought home a cure for the plague.

lines.label: HRE01-C010-020-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Then at least his little sailing trip will have been worth it. I don't see why we all have to fawn over his every action.

lines.label: HRE01-C010-030-LANDEN
lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: Lieutenant Bandarion, we swore an oath to serve the house of Menethil. Now let's prepare the city to welcome our prince home.

lines.label: HRE01-C010-040-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Of course, Captain Landen. I'd hate to disappoint the prince.

lines.label: HRE01-T010-LANDEN
lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: You’re a better guardsman than you let on, Garek. You could make captain yourself if you took things seriously.

lines.label: HRE01-T020-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Are you that eager for me to replace you?

lines.label: HRE01-T030-LANDEN
lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: Of course. I’d love to finally retire.

lines.label: HRE01-T040-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Showering the prince with flowers seems like a little much to me.

lines.label: HRE01-T050-LANDEN
lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: This is an event that calls for celebration, Garek. The people deserve to rejoice.

lines.label: HRE01-T060-GUARDSMAN
lines.speaker: City Guard
lines.text: Is it true? Prince Arthas has finally returned? About time!

lines.label: HRE01-T070-GUARDSMAN
lines.speaker: City Guard
lines.text: Does anyone know why the prince sailed for Northrend at all? What could he possibly want up there?

lines.label: HRE01-T080-GUARDSMAN
lines.speaker: City Guard
lines.text: I heard Prince Arthas disbanded the paladin order before he left. Why would he do that?

lines.label: HRE01-T100-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: You'll have to move your cart ma'am, it's blocking the palace gates.

lines.label: HRE01-T110-ALICIA
lines.speaker: Alicia
lines.text: But the wheel is beyond repair!

lines.label: HRE01-T120-LANDEN
lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: Don't worry, we'll find you a new one.

lines.label: HRE01-T130-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Gold well spent. We could just push the cart out of the prince’s way.

lines.label: HRE01-T140-LANDEN
lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: Then it would still be broken. Our job is to help people, not push them aside.

lines.label: HRE01-T150-ALICIA
lines.speaker: Alicia
lines.text: Oh, thank you! Please take this token of gratitude.

lines.label: HRE01-T160-MERCHANT
lines.speaker: Eugene
lines.text: Stop! Thief!

lines.label: HRE01-T170-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: After him!

lines.label: HRE01-T180-LANDEN
lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: I won’t let Prince Arthas return to a city riddled with crime.

lines.label: HRE01-T190-LUCA
lines.speaker: Luca
lines.text: I saw it! Prince Arthas purged Stratholme! He killed them all!

lines.label: HRE01-T200-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: We'd better check that out.

lines.label: HRE01-T210-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Move along!

lines.label: HRE01-T220-LANDEN
lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: You can sober up at home or in a cell. Your choice.

lines.label: HRE01-T230-LUCA
lines.speaker: Luca
lines.text: I know what I saw!

lines.label: HRE01-T240-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Can you believe what he was saying?

lines.label: HRE01-T250-LANDEN
lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: Baseless rumors. No one really knows what happened in Stratholme, but I’m sure Prince Arthas did all he could for his subjects.

lines.label: HRE01-T260-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Well, that was a hard day’s work. I’m sure our dear prince will appreciate it.

lines.label: HRE01-T270-LANDEN
lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: Sounds like Prince Arthas has arrived. Let’s report to our post.

lines.label: HRE01-C020-010-LANDEN
lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: ... Garek.

lines.label: HRE01-C020-010-LANDEN
lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: Garek!

lines.label: HRE01-M015-010-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: No offense, Captain, but I didn't join the city guard to sweep the streets for the royal family.

lines.label: HRE01-M015-020-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: I want to fight in defense of Lordaeron. I want the thrill of battle and the glory of victory.

lines.label: HRE01-M015-030-LANDEN
lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: Garek, I've fought enough wars to know that glory is a myth.

lines.label: HRE01-M015-040-LANDEN
lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: Survival is the real victory, and peace is its reward. Never lose sight of that.

lines.label: HRE01-M015-050-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: But wait... do you hear that?

lines.label: HRE01-T280-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: What the hell was that?

lines.label: HRE01-T290-LANDEN
lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: I don't... Garek! Look out!

lines.label: FootmanWarcry1
lines.speaker: City Guard
lines.text: For Lordaeron!

lines.label: PriestYesAttack1
lines.speaker: Priest
lines.text: Begone spawn of darkness!

lines.label: FootmanYesAttack3
lines.speaker: City Guard
lines.text: To arms!

lines.label: BanditYesAttack3
lines.speaker: Assassin
lines.text: Get 'em!

lines.label: HRE01-T470-BLIGHTWEAVER
lines.speaker: Blightweaver
lines.text: Our plans come to pass! Death claims you all!

lines.label: NecromancerYesAttack2
lines.speaker: Necromancer
lines.text: Tremble before the Scourge!

lines.label: HRE01-T480-BLIGHTWEAVER
lines.speaker: Blightweaver
lines.text: How long I have waited this day!

lines.label: HRE01-T300-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: The door's locked!

lines.label: HRE01-T310-LANDEN
lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: We need another way in. Hurry!

lines.label: HRE01-T320-ARTHAS
lines.speaker: Arthas
lines.text: This kingdom shall fall, and from the ashes will arise a new order, that will shake the very foundations of the world!

lines.label: HRE01-T330-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: So the rumors were true... Prince Arthas has lost his mind!

lines.label: HRE01-M020-010-LANDEN
lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: King Terenas! No!

lines.label: HRE01-T340-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: The undead! Captain, we have to join the battle!

lines.label: HRE01-T350-LANDEN
lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: What happened here?!

lines.label: HRE01-T360-THRONEROOMGUARD
lines.speaker: City Guard
lines.text: It--It was Prince Arthas, sir! He killed the king! His own father!

lines.label: HRE01-T370-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: He’s in league with these monsters?!

lines.label: HRE01-T380-LORDVILEOR
lines.speaker: Lord Vileor
lines.text: At long last, the Cult of the Damned will lay waste to Lordaeron!

lines.label: HRE01-T390-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Is there no end to them? We need a way out of here!

lines.label: HRE01-C030-010-LANDEN
lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: Uther the Lightbringer!

lines.label: HRE01-C030-020-UTHER
lines.speaker: Uther
lines.text: Guardsmen! Are you hurt?

lines.label: HRE01-C030-030-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: No, sir...

lines.label: HRE01-C030-040-LANDEN
lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: But King Terenas...

lines.label: HRE01-C030-050-UTHER
lines.speaker: Uther
lines.text: My king...

lines.label: HRE01-M030-010-LANDEN
lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: Lord Uther, what is happening out there?

lines.label: HRE01-M030-020-UTHER
lines.speaker: Uther
lines.text: The city is overrun with cultists and the undead. Arthas has betrayed us all!

lines.label: HRE01-M030-030-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: What?!

lines.label: HRE01-M030-040-UTHER
lines.speaker: Uther
lines.text: I was too late to save Terenas, but I will bring his traitorous son to justice.

lines.label: HRE01-M030-050-UTHER
lines.speaker: Uther
lines.text: The two of you rally the city guard and rescue as many civilians as possible.

lines.label: HRE01-M030-060-UTHER
lines.speaker: Uther
lines.text: We regroup at Andorhal. Light guide you both.

lines.label: HRE01-T400-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Captain... what do we do?

lines.label: HRE01-T410-LANDEN
lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: There’s an old evacuation route through the sewers. Let’s hope it’s still intact.

lines.label: HRE01-T420-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Arthas! That traitor!

lines.label: HRE01-T430-LANDEN
lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: Leave him for Uther! We need to keep moving!

lines.label: HRE01-M040-010-LANDEN
lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: By the Light...

lines.label: HRE01-M040-020-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: This can't be happening... How could Arthas damn his own kingdom?!

lines.label: HRE01-M040-030-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: We have to fight back! We have to drive out these monsters and reclaim our home!

lines.label: HRE01-M040-040-LANDEN
lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: Garek, listen to me. The city is lost, but it can be rebuilt. What matters is protecting its people.

lines.label: HRE01-M040-050-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: I... I understand. Let's get to the sewers.

lines.label: HRE01-T500-GUARD1
lines.speaker: City Guard
lines.text: Captain Landen! Lieutenant Bandarion!

lines.label: HRE01-T510-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: With us, guardsmen!

lines.label: HRE01-T520-SURVIVOR
lines.speaker: Villager
lines.text: Thank the Light! There are more survivors trapped on the other side of the palace!

lines.label: HRE01-T530-LANDEN
lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: We’ll do our best to save them. Stay here while we clear a path!

lines.label: HRE01-T540-RIFLEMAN
lines.speaker: Rifleman
lines.text: Guardsmen! We’ve got yer back!

lines.label: NecromancerYesAttack3
lines.speaker: Necromancer
lines.text: None shall survive!

lines.label: GhoulWhat4
lines.speaker: Ghoul
lines.text: Must feed!

lines.label: HRE01-T560-GUARD3
lines.speaker: City Guard
lines.text: Over here! We need help!

lines.label: HRE01-T570-LANDEN
lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: The area’s secure for now. Hold this position and wait for our signal!

lines.label: HRE01-C040-010-LANDEN
lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: Almost there! The evacuation route is just ahead!

lines.label: AbominationYes3
lines.speaker: Fudge
lines.text: Rend and tear!

lines.label: HRE01-C040-030-LANDEN
lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: That abomination stands between us and the sewers.

lines.label: HRE01-C040-040-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Not for long.

lines.label: HRE01-T590-LANDEN
lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: The way is clear! Gather the survivors!

lines.label: HRE01-M050-010-GUARD2
lines.speaker: City Guard
lines.text: Captain Landen! We've secured the exit tunnels!

lines.label: HRE01-M050-020-LANDEN
lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: Well done, guardsmen! Everyone into the sewers!

lines.label: HRE01-M050-030-GUARD2
lines.speaker: City Guard
lines.text: Go with the survivors! We'll buy you some time!

lines.label: HRE01-M050-040-LANDEN
lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: For Lordaeron.

lines.label: HRE02-C010-010-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Damn it! How could this have happened? The city lies in ashes...

lines.label: HRE02-C010-020-LANDEN
lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: We have to stay focused. These people are counting on us to lead them to safety.

lines.label: HRE02-C010-030-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: They were counting on us to keep them safe. And we failed.

lines.label: HRE02-C010-040-RIFLEMAN
lines.speaker: Rifleman
lines.text: Look, survivors!

lines.label: HRE02-C010-050-FOOTMAN
lines.speaker: Footman
lines.text: Sir, we were separated from our unit and got lost down here.

lines.label: HRE02-C010-060-LANDEN
lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: We’re headed for the exit tunnel. Help us protect the civilians and we can all get out of here alive.

lines.label: HRE02-T010-LANDEN
lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: Civilians in the back. The rest of us will take point.

lines.label: HRE02-T020-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Arthas is still laying waste to the city...

lines.label: HRE02-T030-LANDEN
lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: If we secure a way out, perhaps more survivors can be saved.

lines.label: HRE02-T040-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Looks like there's only one path forward.

lines.label: HRE02-T050-BLIGHTWEAVER
lines.speaker: Blightweaver
lines.text: There will be no “path forward” for you!

lines.label: HRE02-T060-LANDEN
lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: Everyone, to arms!

lines.label: HRE02-T070-LANDEN
lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: The cult must have followed us into the sewers. We need to keep moving!

lines.label: HRE02-T110-PRISONERM
lines.speaker: Footman
lines.text: The city guard! Please, help me!

lines.label: HRE02-T120-PRISONERM
lines.speaker: Priest
lines.text: Over here! Let me out!

lines.label: HRE02-T130-PRISONERM
lines.speaker: Rifleman
lines.text: Help! Break open the cage!

lines.label: HRE02-T140-PRISONERFOOTMAN
lines.speaker: Footman
lines.text: You have my thanks! Let's get out of here!

lines.label: HRE02-T190-PRISONERRIFLEMAN
lines.speaker: Rifleman
lines.text: I thought I would die in there! These cultists will pay!

lines.label: HRE02-T210-PRISONERPRIEST
lines.speaker: Priest
lines.text: I'm in your debt. I'll fight by your side!

lines.label: HRE02-T230-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Wait... Why are there so many supplies down here?

lines.label: HRE02-T240-MASTERBLIGHTWEAVER
lines.speaker: Master Blightweaver
lines.text: Intruders! Slay them all!

lines.label: HRE02-T250-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: What is this place?!

lines.label: HRE02-M010-010-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Look at all of this! How long have these cultist rats been skulking in the sewers?

lines.label: HRE02-M010-020-LANDEN
lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: They must have been planning this coup for years. Our friends and neighbors...

lines.label: HRE02-M010-030-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: To know this rot has been festering beneath our feet all this time...

lines.label: HRE02-M010-040-LANDEN
lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: We’ll leave the civilians here while we secure the path ahead.

lines.label: HRE02-M010-050-LANDEN
lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: Lock the gates until we return. And if we don’t...

lines.label: HRE02-M010-060-LANDEN
lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: ...then Light be with you.

lines.label: HRE02-M015-010-LORDEARONSOLDIER
lines.speaker: Footman
lines.text: The city guard! I knew there had to be more survivors!

lines.label: HRE02-M015-020-LANDEN
lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: We have a group of civilians with us. Can you open the gate?

lines.label: HRE02-M015-030-LORDEARONSOLDIER
lines.speaker: Footman
lines.text: No, sir. Those damn cultists took apart the winch. You’ll need to get the cogwheels back from them.

lines.label: HRE02-M015-040-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Then it looks like it’s time to hunt some cultists.

lines.label: HRE02-T260-LANDEN
lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: The exit tunnel should be nearby. Stay Sharp.

lines.label: HRE02-T270-APOTHECARYVENOMSPITE
lines.speaker: Apothecary Venomspite
lines.text: You dare interrupt my work?!

lines.label: HRE02-T280-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Those fumes must be the "work" we interrupted. We need a way to clear them out.

lines.label: HRE02-T290-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: That should do it. Let's move.

lines.label: HRE02-T300-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Hmm. This should protect us from the fumes.

lines.label: HRE02-T310-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Ugh! What are these things?!

lines.label: HRE02-T320-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: It's an ambush!

lines.label: HRE02-T330-LANDEN
lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: Too much rubble. We'll have to find another route.

lines.label: HRE02-T340-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Look out!

lines.label: HRE02-T350-LANDEN
lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: There's the exit!

lines.label: HRE02-T360-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Something cold and menacing lurks in this darkness.

lines.label: HRE02-T370-ARAJTHESUMMONER
lines.speaker: Araj the Summoner
lines.text: Foolish mortals. You have sealed your fate!

lines.label: HRE02-T380-ARAJTHESUMMONER
lines.speaker: Araj the Summoner
lines.text: I will return...

lines.label: HRE02-T390-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Foul lich...

lines.label: HRE02-T400-LANDEN
lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: The city's central furnace. It's still pumping heat.

lines.label: HRE02-T410-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: To homes that Arthas turned into charnel houses. We need to shut off the flames.

lines.label: HRE02-T420-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Captain! I hear voices up ahead!

lines.label: HRE02-C020-010-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: That's Baron Rivendare, Master of Stratholme!

lines.label: HRE02-C020-020-LANDEN
lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: My lord! We have a group of civilians-

lines.label: HRE02-C020-030-RIVENDARE
lines.speaker: Baron Rivendare
lines.text: How fortunate. Your survivors will make fine additions to the Scourge.

lines.label: HRE02-C020-040-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: You're a filthy traitor, just like Arthas!

lines.label: HRE02-C020-050-RIVENDARE
lines.speaker: Baron Rivendare
lines.text: Our dear prince is merely an instrument of a far greater plan. One which I helped to devise.

lines.label: HRE02-C020-060-RIVENDARE
lines.speaker: Baron Rivendare
lines.text: Now this weak and pathetic kingdom will die, and from its corpse will rise an army of the damned.

lines.label: HRE02-C020-070-RIVENDARE
lines.speaker: Baron Rivendare
lines.text: These vermin are beneath me. Slaughter them and hunt down the rest of the survivors.

lines.label: HRE02-T430-MORDO
lines.speaker: Mordo
lines.text: Rivendare will reward me for this!

lines.label: HRE02-T440-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Die, cultist scum!

lines.label: HRE02-T450-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: I'll see Rivendare's head on a pike!

lines.label: HRE02-T460-LANDEN
lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: Justice will find him, Garek. We need to focus on bringing the survivors to Andorhal.

lines.label: HRE02-T470-LANDEN
lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: Thank the Light! Stay here, I'll go back to gather the survivors.

lines.label: HRE02-T470-LANDEN
lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: Thank the Light! Stay here, I'll go back to gather the survivors.

lines.label: HRE02-M020-010-LANDEN
lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: Everyone head to the surface!

lines.label: HRE02-M020-020-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: No, Captain. You can get the survivors to Andorhal without me.

lines.label: HRE02-M020-030-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: I’m not leaving here while Rivendare draws breath.

lines.label: HRE02-M020-040-LANDEN
lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: Garek, this is madness. You can't possibly-

lines.label: HRE02-M020-050-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Justice won't find him unless someone brings it to him. If not now, then when?

lines.label: HRE02-M020-060-LANDEN
lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: Soldier, I leave these civilians in your charge.

lines.label: HRE02-M020-070-LANDEN
lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: Let’s make this quick, Lieutenant.

lines.label: HRE02-T480-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: You don't have to do this, sir.

lines.label: HRE02-T490-LANDEN
lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: Yes I do. I'm not letting you face Rivendare alone.

lines.label: HRE02-T500-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: These spiders are huge...

lines.label: HRE02-T510-LANDEN
lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: There must be a broodmother nearby.

lines.label: HRE02-T520-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Captain! Get me out of these webs!

lines.label: HRE02-T530-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: She's webbed me up! I can't move!

lines.label: HRE02-T540-LANDEN
lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: Garek! Cut these webs and free me!

lines.label: HRE02-T550-LANDEN
lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: I'm ensnared! Free me, quickly!

lines.label: HRE02-T560-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Wretched beast!

lines.label: HRE02-T570-LANDEN
lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: With the broodmother dead, the swarm should scatter.

lines.label: HRE02-T580-LANDEN
lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: What vile sorcery is this?

lines.label: HRE02-T590-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Whatever it is, it ends now!

lines.label: HRE02-T600-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Rivendare! You will pay for your crimes!

lines.label: HRE02-T610-RIVENDARE
lines.speaker: Baron Rivendare
lines.text: More lambs to the slaughter!

lines.label: HRE02-C030-010-RIVENDARE
lines.speaker: Baron Rivendare
lines.text: How eagerly you sought your own death. So quick to play the hero.

lines.label: HRE02-C030-020-RIVENDARE
lines.speaker: Baron Rivendare
lines.text: But you are no one! Merely another corpse to serve--

lines.label: HRE02-C030-040-LANDEN
lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: The barrier is down! Run!

lines.label: HRE02-C030-050-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: What?! No! I’m not abandoning you!

lines.label: HRE02-C030-060-LANDEN
lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: Forget about me! You need to get the civilians to Andorhal!

lines.label: HRE02-C030-070-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Captain, I--

lines.label: HRE02-C030-080-LANDEN
lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: That’s an order, damn it!

lines.label: HRE02-C030-090-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Light be with you, sir.

lines.label: HRE02-C030-100-LANDEN
lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: Go, Garek. Be who you were meant to be.

lines.label: HRE02-C030-110-RIVENDARE
lines.speaker: Baron Rivendare
lines.text: You think you can escape?! These sewers will be your tomb!

lines.label: HRE02-C030-120-LANDEN
lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: For Lordaeron!

lines.label: HRE02-T630-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Captain... I'm sorry...

lines.label: HRE02-T640-RIVENDARE
lines.speaker: Baron Rivendare
lines.text: Run all you like, little rat! I'll catch you yet!

lines.label: HRE02-T650-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Need to put some debris in his way. Breaking these support pillars should do it.

lines.label: HRE02-T670-RIVENDARE
lines.speaker: Baron Rivendare
lines.text: You cannot escape your fate. All of Lordaeron will fall to the Scourge!

lines.label: HRE02-M030-010-LORDEARONSOLDIER
lines.speaker: Footman
lines.text: Lieutenant Bandarion, you’re alive! But... where’s Captain Landen?

lines.label: HRE02-M030-020-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: He... he didn't make it.

lines.label: HRE02-M030-030-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: We need to regroup with Uther at Andorhal. Let's get moving.

lines.label: HRE02I-M010-010-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Lord Uther! Did you face Prince Arthas?

lines.label: HRE02I-M010-020-UTHER
lines.speaker: Uther
lines.text: No. By the time I had consecrated Terenas's remains, Arthas had left the city.

lines.label: HRE02I-M010-023-UTHER
lines.speaker: Uther
lines.text: Your captain is not with you. Did he...

lines.label: HRE02I-M010-025-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: He was murdered by that traitor Rivendare. If not for Captain Landen, I'd be dead too.

lines.label: HRE02I-M010-028-UTHER
lines.speaker: Uther
lines.text: I grieve with you, Lieutenant. We must ensure that his sacrifice was not made in vain.

lines.label: HRE02I-M010-030-UTHER
lines.speaker: Uther
lines.text: Unfortunately, Andorhal is now surrounded by cultists and necromancers. We don’t have the strength to break their siege.

lines.label: HRE02I-M010-040-UTHER
lines.speaker: Uther
lines.text: I will bring the survivors to Hearthglen and gather reinforcements. You remain here and harry the cultists until I return.

lines.label: HRE02I-M010-050-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Understood, sir.

lines.label: HRE02I-M010-060-UTHER
lines.speaker: Uther
lines.text: The cult must not take Andorhal. Light guide your path.

lines.label: HRE03-M010-010-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: We need to buy Andorhal time until Uther returns with reinforcements. Let’s move.

lines.label: HRE03-T010-ILASTAR
lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: These wretched cultists will not win the day!

lines.label: HRE03-T020-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Theyre under attack! Forward!

lines.label: HRE03-M020-010-ILASTAR
lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: Thank you, stranger. You’re from the capital, aren’t you? Is it true that Arthas set it aflame?

lines.label: HRE03-M020-020-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: It is. Lord Uther ordered us to regroup in Andorhal. He’s gathering troops to break the siege.

lines.label: HRE03-M020-030-ILASTAR
lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: He may already be too late. The cult is preparing to launch a massive assault on the city.

lines.label: HRE03-M020-040-ILASTAR
lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: I had planned to muster troops for a preemptive strike, but first we need to establish a base.

lines.label: HRE03-M020-050-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: We can help with that. If we keep the cult occupied, we can delay their attack until Uther arrives.

lines.label: HRE03-M020-060-ILASTAR
lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: Very well. Ilastar Songbreeze, at your service.

lines.label: HRE03-M020-070-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Garek Bandarion, at yours. Let’s fight some cultists.

lines.label: HRE03-T030-ILASTAR
lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: We need to repair the Lumber Mill if this is to be a proper base.

lines.label: HRE03-T040-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Off to a good start, but we'll need more resources to build an army.

lines.label: HRE03-T050-ILASTAR
lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: There are other settlements nearby. We should reclaim them as well.

lines.label: HRE03-T060-ILASTAR
lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: Here's one of the outlying settlements. Good people once called it home.

lines.label: FootmanWhat3
lines.speaker: Footman
lines.text: Yes my liege?

lines.label: RiflemanWhat3
lines.speaker: Rifleman
lines.text: I'm your shooter!

lines.label: RiflemanWhat1
lines.speaker: Rifleman
lines.text: Aye sir!

lines.label: FootmanWarcry1
lines.speaker: Footman
lines.text: For Lordaeron!

lines.label: FootmanYesAttack3
lines.speaker: Footman
lines.text: To arms!

lines.label: PriestWhat3
lines.speaker: Priest
lines.text: Is my aid required?

lines.label: PriestYes1
lines.speaker: Priest
lines.text: I am your servant.

lines.label: PeasantWhat3
lines.speaker: Peasant
lines.text: More work?

lines.label: PeasantHelp
lines.speaker: Peasant
lines.text: Help! Help!

lines.label: PeasantHelp
lines.speaker: Peasant
lines.text: Help! Help!

lines.label: PeasantHelp
lines.speaker: Peasant
lines.text: Help! Help!

lines.label: PeasantHelp
lines.speaker: Peasant
lines.text: Help! Help!

lines.label: HRE03-T070-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: We'll need to bring in workers from our base to begin repairs.

lines.label: HRE03-T080-ILASTAR
lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: At least the cult didn't slaughter the horses.

lines.label: HRE03-T090-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Our knights will ride them into battle and avenge the fallen.

lines.label: HRE03-T100-ILASTAR
lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: This was a house of worship! Is nothing sacred to these heathens?!

lines.label: HRE03-T110-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Your fellow priests will smite them in return.

lines.label: HRE03-T120-ILASTAR
lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: The family who lived here wanted a quiet life outside of the city.

lines.label: HRE03-T130-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: We'll make use of their provisions and bring their killers to justice.

lines.label: HRE03-T140-ILASTAR
lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: I knew the owners of this gunshop. They took pride in their craft.

lines.label: HRE03-T150-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Their wares will arm our riflemen and fill the cult with lead.

lines.label: HRE03-T160-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: The cult's undead minions seem endless in number.

lines.label: HRE03-T170-ILASTAR
lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: Their fetid ghouls will continue to swarm us unless we destroy their plague cauldrons.

lines.label: HRE03-T180-ILASTAR
lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: That should afford us a little more breathing room.

lines.label: BanditWarcry1
lines.speaker: Assassin
lines.text: Ambush!

lines.label: HRE03-T190-RAS
lines.speaker: Ras Frostwhisper
lines.text: It seems we have unwelcome company. Exterminate them.

lines.label: HRE03-T200-RAS
lines.speaker: Ras Frostwhisper
lines.text: My master bids this city annihilated! I will see it done!

lines.label: HRE03-T210-RAS
lines.speaker: Ras Frostwhisper
lines.text: Only a fool would dare to oppose the Cult of the Damned.

lines.label: HRE03-T220-RAS
lines.speaker: Ras Frostwhisper
lines.text: Andorhal will burn like the rest of Lordaeron. You cannot stop us!

lines.label: HRE03-T230-RAS
lines.speaker: Ras Frostwhisper
lines.text: Why struggle in futility? The Scourge reigns supreme.

lines.label: HRE03-T240-RAS
lines.speaker: Ras Frostwhisper
lines.text: Stubborn imbeciles! I will return with even greater forces!

lines.label: HRE03-T250-RAS
lines.speaker: Ras Frostwhisper
lines.text: You will pay dearly for your insolence! This isn't over!

lines.label: HRE03-T260-RAS
lines.speaker: Ras Frostwhisper
lines.text: I've dealt with worse miscreants than you! Victory will be mine!

lines.label: HRE03-T270-RAS
lines.speaker: Ras Frostwhisper
lines.text: This is a mere distraction! More pressing matters await my attention!

lines.label: HRE03-T280-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: The forest is clear. Now to break the rest of the siege.

lines.label: HRE03-M030-010-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Lord Uther! Are these all of the reinforcements?

lines.label: HRE03-M030-020-UTHER
lines.speaker: Uther
lines.text: I’m afraid so. With the Silver Hand disbanded, we paladins are spread thin across Lordaeron.

lines.label: HRE03-M030-030-ILASTAR
lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: No... that bell means that the cult has breached the gates!

lines.label: HRE03-M030-040-UTHER
lines.speaker: Uther
lines.text: Then the real battle has begun.

lines.label: HRE03-M030-050-UTHER
lines.speaker: Uther
lines.text: Lead your forces into the city while my paladins and I flank the cultists outside the walls.

lines.label: HRE03-M030-060-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Yes, sir! We won’t let Andorhal fall to the Scourge!

lines.label: HRE03-T290-ILASTAR
lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: If we retake the guard towers, we can drive this vile cultists out of Andorhal!

lines.label: HRE03-T300-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: The militia is fighting in the streets! We'll join forces with them!

lines.label: FootmanWarcry1
lines.speaker: Footman
lines.text: For Lordaeron!

lines.label: PeasantYesAttack3
lines.speaker: Militia
lines.text: No one else available?

lines.label: FootmanYesAttack3
lines.speaker: Footman
lines.text: To arms!

lines.label: PeasantYesAttack3
lines.speaker: Militia
lines.text: No one else available?

lines.label: FootmanWarcry1
lines.speaker: Footman
lines.text: For Lordaeron!

lines.label: FootmanYesAttack3
lines.speaker: Footman
lines.text: To arms!

lines.label: HRE03-T310-ILASTAR
lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: These people need our help!

lines.label: HRE03-T320-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Save everyone you can!

lines.label: HRE03-T330-ILASTAR
lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: More plague cauldrons. We should destroy them before the city is overrun!

lines.label: HRE03-T340-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: If we clear a path for Uther's paladins, they can join us in the city streets.

lines.label: HRE03-T350-RAS
lines.speaker: Ras Frostwhisper
lines.text: Enough of your meddling. I'll deal with you permanently!

lines.label: HRE03-M040-010-RAS
lines.speaker: Ras Frostwhisper
lines.text: No! You will not deny me my reward!

lines.label: HRE03-M040-020-RAS
lines.speaker: Ras Frostwhisper
lines.text: Within Stratholme, I will be granted power everlasting! When next we meet, you will all die!

lines.label: HRE03-M040-030-UTHER
lines.speaker: Uther
lines.text: Andorhal is secure, though it will take time to rebuild it.

lines.label: HRE03-M040-040-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Stratholme was Rivendare’s seat of power. If that’s where the cult is gathering, he’ll be there too.

lines.label: HRE03-M040-050-UTHER
lines.speaker: Uther
lines.text: I know he struck down your captain. But the Light calls us to protect those who yet live. Trust in its judgment, Lieutenant Bandarion.

lines.label: HRE03-M040-060-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: I can't just sit behind these walls while Rivendare goes unpunished.

lines.label: HRE03-M040-070-ILASTAR
lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: Nor can I. The Light calls for retribution as well, and we must deliver it to the cult.

lines.label: HRE03-M040-080-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Then that’s what we’ll do. We ride for Stratholme, before Lord Uther says otherwise.

lines.label: HRE04-M010-010-ILASTAR
lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: Look at what Arthas left in his wake. How many more cities will he burn? How many lives will he claim?

lines.label: HRE04-M010-020-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Rivendare is the one who set this in motion. We're going to end him here and now.

lines.label: HRE04-M010-030-ILASTAR
lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: Indeed. The city will be well fortified, but I can enter the side gate and raise the portcullises.

lines.label: HRE04-M010-040-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: A sound plan. Stay safe until we can regroup with you.

lines.label: HRE04-M010-050-ILASTAR
lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: And you, Garek. May the Light guide your blade.

lines.label: HRE04-T010-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text:
Crates of grain, infected with the plague. This is how Rivendare 
doomed his people.

lines.label: HRE04-T020-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: The gate is locked. We’ll have to wait for Ilastar to open it.

lines.label: HRE04-T030-ILASTAR
lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: Alonsus Chapel. What sacrilege have the cult inflicted upon it?

lines.label: HRE04-T040-ILASTAR
lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: The way is open. I will remain up here and scout ahead.

lines.label: HRE04-T050-MORTARTEAM
lines.speaker: Mortar Team
lines.text: Are you... alive? Thank the Light! We’ve been surrounded by the Scourge for weeks!

lines.label: HRE04-T060-ILASTAR
lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: I can’t face them alone. Garek’s mortar teams can help from afar.

lines.label: HRE04-T070-ILASTAR
lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: By the Light! The spores from those mushrooms are spreading the plague. They cannot be allowed to grow!

lines.label: HRE04-T080-ILASTAR
lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: Let these vile spores choke on the ashes of this ruined city.

lines.label: HRE04-T090-RIFLEMAN
lines.speaker: Rifleman
lines.text: Reinforcements! I told ye we just had to hang on a little longer!

lines.label: HRE04-T100-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Focus on the Crypt, before it makes short work of us!

lines.label: HRE04-T110-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Ilastar, how do you fare?

lines.label: HRE04-T120-ILASTAR
lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: Well enough. I will heal you as best as I can from up here.

lines.label: HRE04-T130-RAS
lines.speaker: Ras Frostwhisper
lines.text: The cowardly mages of the Kirin Tor spurned my talent and ambition. But the Lich King will reward it!

lines.label: HRE04-T140-RAS
lines.speaker: Ras Frostwhisper
lines.text: I now cast aside this wretched flesh and blood, and embrace the immortality of undeath!

lines.label: HRE04-T150-RAS
lines.speaker: Ras Frostwhisper
lines.text: Behold! I arise anew, perfected in form and power!

lines.label: HRE04-T160-RAS
lines.speaker: Ras Frostwhisper
lines.text: Leonid! Tell my students to do as they wish. A greater destiny awaits me now!

lines.label: HRE04-T170-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: The gate’s still closed. There must be a second lever.

lines.label: HRE04-T180-ILASTAR
lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: The gate remains shut. There must be another lever.

lines.label: HRE04-T200-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: The gates are open! Frostwhisper will taste our steel!

lines.label: HRE04-T200-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: The gates are open! Frostwhisper will taste our steel!

lines.label: HRE04-T210-RAS
lines.speaker: Ras Frostwhisper
lines.text: Ah, back for more, are you? This time I will flay you alive!

lines.label: HRE04-T220-RAS
lines.speaker: Ras Frostwhisper
lines.text: You cannot kill me so easily, mortals. We will meet again.

lines.label: HRE04-T230-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Forget about him. Our true target is Rivendare.

lines.label: HRE04-T400-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: It looks like some tried to flee Stratholme by sea. The cult must have sunk their ship.

lines.label: HRE04-T410-ILASTAR
lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: We should recover their supplies. They can aid the war effort.

lines.label: HRE04-T420-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Those should be enough supplies. Time to get back to land.

lines.label: HRE04-T430-ILASTAR
lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: The streets are infested with the undead. Best avoid them if we can.

lines.label: HRE04-T440-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Here they come! Be ready to fight!

lines.label: HRE04-T450-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: The gate’s locked. We won’t get through without a key.

lines.label: HRE04-T460-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: The road to Crusader’s Square is open. Rivendare can’t hide forever.

lines.label: HRE04-T480-LORTHIRAS
lines.speaker: Lorthiras
lines.text: Your suffering will be exquisite.

lines.label: HRE04-T490-LORTHIRAS
lines.speaker: Lorthiras
lines.text: This is not the end, little mortals.

lines.label: HRE04-T500-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Stratholme was one of the greatest cities in Lordaeron. Then Rivendare sacrificed it to the undead!

lines.label: HRE04-T510-ILASTAR
lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: He is but one of many to sell his soul to the Scourge. They will all burn in holy fire.

lines.label: HRE04-T520-KNIGHT
lines.speaker: Knight
lines.text: More survivors! Hold the line!

lines.label: HRE04-T530-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Damn, our forces have been split. We need to find the lever that opens the gate.

lines.label: HRE04-T540-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Let's regroup and press forward.

lines.label: HRE04-T580-GRIMTHANE
lines.speaker: Grimthane
lines.text: Your bones will serve the Scourge.

lines.label: HRE04-T590-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Now your bones can join the rest.

lines.label: HRE04-T600-ILASTAR
lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: Here is the profane tower where Rivendare holds court.

lines.label: HRE04-T610-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: I’ll throw him from the parapets once I’ve cut him down.

lines.label: HRE04-T620-ILASTAR
lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: Garek, there could still be survivors throughout the city.

lines.label: HRE04-T630-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Our soldiers can keep searching for civilians in need of rescue.

lines.label: HRE04-T640-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: We’ll regroup in Hearthglen when the deed is done. Now, let’s bring Rivendare to justice.

lines.label: FootmanWarcry1
lines.speaker: Footman
lines.text: For Lordaeron!

lines.label: FootmanYesAttack3
lines.speaker: Footman
lines.text: To arms!

lines.label: SorceressYesAttack2
lines.speaker: Sorceress
lines.text: Now victory shall be ours!

lines.label: FootmanPissed4
lines.speaker: Footman
lines.text: It's only a flesh wound...

lines.label: PriestReady1
lines.speaker: Priest
lines.text: I come to cleanse this land.

lines.label: RiflemanReady1
lines.speaker: Rifleman
lines.text: Locked and loaded!

lines.label: MortarTeamWhat1
lines.speaker: Mortar Team
lines.text: Let's get to fightin'!

lines.label: HRE04-M030-010-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Rivendare! You will answer for your crimes with your death!

lines.label: HRE04-M030-020-RIVENDARE
lines.speaker: Baron Rivendare
lines.text: Death? What do you know of death?

lines.label: HRE04-M030-030-RIVENDARE
lines.speaker: Baron Rivendare
lines.text: I have seen and wielded its true power! The Lich King has exalted me above foolish weaklings like you!

lines.label: HRE04-M030-040-RIVENDARE
lines.speaker: Baron Rivendare
lines.text: Now I will draw the screams out of you, as I did with your pathetic captain!

lines.label: HRE04-M030-050-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: You don't deserve to speak his name! Die like the vermin you are! For Landen!

lines.label: HRE04-T650-RIVENDARE
